rationale:
Split: yes, into 6 children. Four reuse comparator-accepted declarations whose frozen types are identical; two are new.

What the parent is. The selected theorem is the conjunction (a) latticeFace ρ F ⊆ Pc.support ∧ (b) ENNReal.ofReal(|β F|·ρ^(m+1)) ≤ Pc.mass, under shared hypotheses.

Part (b) is reused as is. Its type is, byte for byte, the frozen lean_statement of the accepted declaration isoperimetric_lattice_chain_mass_ge (node root.isoperimetric-a1.lattice_mass_lower_bound-a1, status accepted, candidate b1a770c3). It does not even need β F ≠ 0. Its accepted proof is the parent's step 7 with δ = 1/q, using the shrunken-face cut-off as ψ_q, exactly as the parent's Remark anticipates. Child key: mass_ge.

Part (a) is reduced to one new localized construction:
- local_isolating_form (new, fiw_tb_lcc_local_isolating_form). For every point x of the closed face F₀ and every open W ∋ x, there is a test form ω ∈ TestFormOn univ n with tsupport ω ⊆ W, [[F]](ω) = 0 for every F ≠ F₀, and [[F₀]](ω) > 0.
- It uses three accepted declarations, reused with identical types:
  - isoperimetric_coord_covector_eval (parent step 2);
  - isoperimetric_lattice_face_cutoff, which replaces the ball separation of step 3 (the parent's Remark notes this cut-off vanishes on all other faces of direction α₀, which is all step 4 uses);
  - br_latticeFace_setIntegral_eq_cube (parent step 1).
- It also uses one new analytic lemma, face_integral_pos (fiw_tb_lcc_face_integral_pos): the face integral of a continuous g ≥ 0 that is positive at a relative-interior point is positive (the positivity half of step 5).
- The closure argument of step 6 is made local: the point p = x + t(c − x) on the segment from x to the centre c is chosen inside W.

Children imply the parent, by the supplied proof. Fix m, N, ρ > 0, β, Pc with IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc, and F with β F ≠ 0.
(a) Let x ∈ latticeFace ρ F and suppose x ∉ Pc.support = univ \ Pc.zeroRegion.
- Then x ∈ Pc.zeroRegion = ⋃₀{W : IsOpen W ∧ IsCompact (closure W) ∧ closure W ⊆ univ ∧ Pc.VanishesOn W}, so some open W ∋ x has Pc(η) = 0 whenever tsupport η ⊆ W.
- local_isolating_form with (m+1, N, ρ, F, x, W) gives ω, and VanishesOn gives Pc(ω) = 0.
- IsLatticeChain and tsum_eq_single F (every other term is β_G·0 = 0) give Pc(ω) = β_F·[[F]](ω). This is nonzero as a product of nonzero reals: a contradiction.
(b) is isoperimetric_lattice_chain_mass_ge m N ρ β Pc hρ hPc F.

subproblems.title: Lattice-chain mass lower bound |β_F|ρ^(m+1) ≤ M(Pc) (reused accepted declaration)
subproblems.statement: Let m, N ∈ ℕ, ρ ∈ ℝ with ρ > 0, β : LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) N → ℝ and Pc ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^N) (a GeometricCurrentOn univ (m+1)) with IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc, i.e. Pc(ω) = Σ'_F β_F · latticeFaceAction ρ F ω for every test form ω ∈ TestFormOn univ (m+1). Then for every face index F ∈ LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) N: |β_F| · ρ^(m+1) ≤ M(Pc), stated in [0, ∞] as ENNReal.ofReal(|β_F| · ρ^(m+1)) ≤ Pc.mass.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (β : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) N → ℝ) (Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) (m + 1)), 0 < ρ → IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc → ∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) N, ENNReal.ofReal (|β F| * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Pc.mass
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: the accepted proof of the reused declaration isoperimetric_lattice_chain_mass_ge, reproduced.
- Node: root.isoperimetric-a1.lattice_mass_lower_bound-a1, candidate commit b1a770c375be212de585c186965d7d1f653fb13a. Its frozen Lean type is identical, so the comparator-accepted declaration is reused.
- This is step 7 of the parent proof with δ = 1/q, using the cut-off of the shrunken face as ψ_q (as the parent's Remark proposes).
- The accepted Lean proof factors steps 1–4 below into the accepted lemmas isoperimetric_coord_covector_eval, isoperimetric_coord_box_measure, isoperimetric_lattice_face_cutoff and isoperimetric_lattice_face_isolating_form. Here they are proved inline.

Notation.
- n := m + 1; H := μHE[n] on ℝ^N; e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1.
- F₀ = (z, α) is the given face (α : Fin n ↪o Fin N strictly increasing), and A := range α.
- dx^α := wedgeCovectors n (i ↦ EuclideanSpace.proj (α i)).
- [[F]](ω) := latticeFaceAction ρ F ω = ∫_{latticeFace ρ F} ω(x)(e_{F.2(0)}, …, e_{F.2(n−1)}) dH(x).
- For δ ∈ ℝ, K_δ := {x : ρ(z_i + δ) ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − δ) (i ∈ A), x_i = ρz_i (i ∉ A)}. In particular K_0 = latticeFace ρ F₀.

1. Coordinate covector. Let I : Fin n → Fin N be strictly increasing. By wedgeCovectors_apply_det, dx^α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}) = det[δ_{α(i), I(j)}]_{i,j}.
 - If I = α, this is the identity matrix, so the value is 1.
 - If I ≠ α, then some α(i) ∉ range I: two strictly increasing maps on Fin n with equal ranges coincide. Row i is then zero, so the value is 0.
 Hence dx^α(e_α) = 1 and dx^α(e_{α'}) = 0 for α' ≠ α. Also covectorEuclideanNorm(c • dx^α) = sqrt(c²) = |c|, since the only nonzero summand of the coefficient-norm sum is the one at I = α.
2. Box measures. Let c_i := ρz_i and a ≤ b, and set B(a, b) := {x : c_i + a ≤ x_i ≤ c_i + b (i ∈ A), x_i = c_i (i ∉ A)}. Then H(B(a, b)) = (b − a)^n:
 - ι(y)_i := c_i + Σ_j [α(j) = i] y_j is an isometry ℝ^n → ℝ^N (α injective) mapping [a, b]^n onto B(a, b);
 - μHE[n] is invariant under isometries (Isometry.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image);
 - on ℝ^n it equals Lebesgue measure (EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume, PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp, Real.volume_Icc_pi).
 Hence H(latticeFace ρ F₀) = H(B(0, ρ)) = ρ^n, and for 0 < δ < 1/2, H(K_δ) = H(B(ρδ, ρ(1 − δ))) = (ρ(1 − 2δ))^n.
3. Cut-off. Fix 0 < δ < 1/4.
 - Let L := {x : ρ(z_i + δ/2) ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − δ/2) (i ∈ A), |x_i − ρz_i| ≤ ρ/2 (i ∉ A)}. It is closed and lies in the compact box Π_i [ρz_i − ρ, ρz_i + ρ], so it is compact.
 - Let O be the same set with strict inequalities; O is open.
 - K_δ is closed and K_δ ⊆ O ⊆ L, so K_δ ⊆ interior L.
 - Smooth Urysohn (exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior) gives a C^∞ φ : ℝ^N → [0, 1] with φ = 1 on K_δ and φ = 0 off L. So φ has compact support.
 - Let z' ≠ z and x ∈ latticeFace ρ (z', α), and pick i with z'_i ≠ z_i, so |z'_i − z_i| ≥ 1. If i ∈ A, x_i ∈ [ρz'_i, ρ(z'_i + 1)] lies outside [ρ(z_i + δ/2), ρ(z_i + 1 − δ/2)]. If i ∉ A, |x_i − ρz_i| = ρ|z'_i − z_i| ≥ ρ > ρ/2. Either way x ∉ L, so φ(x) = 0.
4. Isolating form. ω := φ • dx^α is a C^∞ compactly supported n-form, so ω ∈ TestFormOn univ n.
 - ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ n univ, because covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) = |φ(x)| ≤ 1 (step 1).
 - Let F = (z', α') ≠ F₀. If α' = α, then z' ≠ z and the integrand φ(x)·dx^α(e_α) vanishes on latticeFace ρ F (step 3). If α' ≠ α, the integrand is φ(x)·dx^α(e_{α'}) = 0 (step 1). So [[F]](ω) = 0.
 - [[F₀]](ω) = ∫_{latticeFace ρ F₀} φ dH ≥ ∫_{K_δ} φ dH = H(K_δ) = (ρ(1 − 2δ))^n, by setIntegral_mono_set and step 2. This uses that φ ≥ 0; that φ is integrable on the face (|φ| ≤ 1 and H(face) = ρ^n < ∞); that K_δ ⊆ latticeFace ρ F₀ is closed; and that φ = 1 on K_δ.
5. Evaluation. Every term of the series with F ≠ F₀ is β_F · 0 = 0. So IsLatticeChain and tsum_eq_single give Pc(ω) = β_{F₀}·[[F₀]](ω).
6. Sign. −ω is admissible too (covectorEuclideanNorm_neg), and Pc(−ω) = −Pc(ω) by linearity.
 - If β_{F₀} ≥ 0, then |β_{F₀}|(ρ(1 − 2δ))^n ≤ β_{F₀}[[F₀]](ω) = Pc(ω).
 - If β_{F₀} < 0, then |β_{F₀}|(ρ(1 − 2δ))^n ≤ −β_{F₀}[[F₀]](ω) = Pc(−ω).
 In both cases, monotonicity of ENNReal.ofReal and GeometricCurrentOn.le_massOn give ENNReal.ofReal(|β_{F₀}|(ρ(1 − 2δ))^n) ≤ Pc.massOn univ = Pc.mass.
7. Limit. The map δ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal(|β_{F₀}|(ρ(1 − 2δ))^n) is continuous, with value ENNReal.ofReal(|β_{F₀}|ρ^n) at δ = 0. The bound of step 6 holds on (0, 1/4), which belongs to 𝓝[>] 0 (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT). So le_of_tendsto gives ENNReal.ofReal(|β_{F₀}|·ρ^(m+1)) ≤ Pc.mass. The hypothesis β_{F₀} ≠ 0 is not needed. ∎
proof_key_steps: Coordinate covector dx^α is Kronecker on increasing coordinate frames, and covectorEuclideanNorm(c·dx^α) = |c|.
Box measures: H^n(face) = ρ^n and H^n(K_δ) = (ρ(1−2δ))^n, via an isometry of ℝ^n.
Smooth Urysohn cut-off φ: equal to 1 on K_δ, vanishing on every other face of direction α.
ω = φ dx^α is mass-admissible, kills every other face, and [[F₀]](ω) ≥ (ρ(1−2δ))^n.
Pc(±ω) = ±β_{F₀}[[F₀]](ω) gives ofReal(|β_{F₀}|(ρ(1−2δ))^n) ≤ M(Pc); let δ → 0⁺.

subproblems.title: Coordinate covector dx^α is dual to the coordinate frames (reused accepted declaration)
subproblems.statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and α ∈ SimonMultiIndex n N (a strictly increasing α : Fin n ↪o Fin N). Let dx^α := wedgeCovectors n (i ↦ EuclideanSpace.proj (α i)), the constant n-covector on ℝ^N with dx^α(v_1, …, v_n) = det[(v_j)_{α(i)}], and e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1. Then: (i) dx^α(e_{α(0)}, …, e_{α(n−1)}) = 1; (ii) dx^α(e_{α'(0)}, …, e_{α'(n−1)}) = 0 for every α' ∈ SimonMultiIndex n N with α' ≠ α; (iii) covectorEuclideanNorm(c • dx^α) = |c| for every c ∈ ℝ. Here covectorEuclideanNorm(ω) = (Σ_{I strictly increasing} ω(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2}.

subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: the accepted proof of the reused declaration isoperimetric_coord_covector_eval, reproduced.
- Node: root.isoperimetric-a1.lattice_mass_lower_bound-a1.coord_covector-a1, candidate commit 3d98b1871057eeff6b4d78f84c5665e21780c082. Its frozen Lean type is identical, so the comparator-accepted declaration is reused.
- It is step 2 of the parent proof.

Notation. η := dx^α := wedgeCovectors n (i ↦ EuclideanSpace.proj (α i)), and e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin N) ℝ a.

1. Kronecker property. Let I : Fin n → Fin N be strictly increasing. By wedgeCovectors_apply_det, η(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}) = det M with M_{ij} = proj_{α(i)}(e_{I(j)}) = [α(i) = I(j)].
 (a) If I = α as functions, then M_{ij} = [α(i) = α(j)] = [i = j] because α is injective. So M is the identity matrix and det M = 1.
 (b) If I ≠ α, there is i with α(i) ∉ range I. Otherwise range α ⊆ range I. Both are sets of cardinality n (α and I are injective; Set.ncard_range_of_injective), so range α = range I (Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le). Strictly monotone maps on Fin n with equal ranges coincide (StrictMono.range_inj_of_wellFoundedLT), contradicting I ≠ α. For this i, M_{ij} = [α(i) = I(j)] = 0 for every j, so row i of M is zero and det M = 0 (Matrix.det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero).
2. (i) is step 1(a) with I := α, which is strictly increasing.
3. (ii): let α' ≠ α in SimonMultiIndex n N. Their underlying functions differ (DFunLike.coe_injective), and α' is strictly increasing, so step 1(b) gives η(e_{α'(0)}, …, e_{α'(n−1)}) = 0.
4. (iii): by definition, covectorEuclideanNorm(c • η) = sqrt(Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin N} [I strictly increasing]·((c • η)(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}))²).
 - For strictly increasing I, the summand is (c·[I = α])² = [I = α]·c² by step 1.
 - For any other I, the summand is 0, and then I ≠ α because α is strictly increasing.
 So every summand equals [I = α]·c², and the sum is c² (Finset.sum_ite_eq'). Hence covectorEuclideanNorm(c • η) = sqrt(c²) = |c| (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs). ∎
proof_key_steps: wedgeCovectors_apply_det: dx^α(e_I) = det[δ_{α(i), I(j)}].
I = α gives the identity matrix; I ≠ α gives a zero row, because strictly increasing maps with equal ranges coincide.
The coefficient-norm sum has the single nonzero term c² at I = α, so covectorEuclideanNorm(c·dx^α) = |c|.

subproblems.title: Smooth cut-off of a lattice face vanishing on all parallel faces (reused accepted declaration)
subproblems.statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, δ > 0, z ∈ ℤ^N, and let α ∈ SimonMultiIndex n N be strictly increasing with A := range α. Let K := {x ∈ ℝ^N : ρ(z_i + δ) ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − δ) for i ∈ A, and x_i = ρ z_i for i ∉ A}. Then there is a C^∞ function φ : ℝ^N → ℝ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) with compact support such that: 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1 everywhere; φ = 1 on K; and φ = 0 on every lattice face latticeFace ρ (z', α) with z' ∈ ℤ^N, z' ≠ z.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (z : Fin N → ℤ) (α : SimonMultiIndex n N), 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ∃ φ : Eucl N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : Eucl N, (∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range α → ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + δ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + 1 - δ)) ∧ (i ∉ range α → x i = ρ * (z i : ℝ))) → φ x = 1) ∧ ∀ z' : Fin N → ℤ, z' ≠ z → ∀ x ∈ latticeFace ρ ((z', α) : LatticeFaceIndex n N), φ x = 0
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: the accepted proof of the reused declaration isoperimetric_lattice_face_cutoff, reproduced.
- Node: root.isoperimetric-a1.lattice_mass_lower_bound-a1.face_cutoff-a1, candidate commit b27494a624bd7cb016c2462cf743040f38ce4183. Its frozen Lean type is identical, so the comparator-accepted declaration is reused.
- It supplies the separation of parallel faces (parent step 3) in exactly the form parent step 4 uses.

Notation.
- A := range α and K as in the statement.
- L := {x : ρ(z_i + δ/2) ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − δ/2) (i ∈ A), |x_i − ρz_i| ≤ ρ/2 (i ∉ A)}.
- O := {x : ρ(z_i + δ/2) < x_i < ρ(z_i + 1 − δ/2) (i ∈ A), |x_i − ρz_i| < ρ/2 (i ∉ A)}.

1. Topology. Each coordinate map x ↦ x_i is continuous on ℝ^N (PiLp.continuous_apply).
 - K and L are finite intersections of closed sets of the forms {a ≤ x_i}, {x_i ≤ b}, {x_i = b} and {|x_i − b| ≤ r}, so they are closed.
 - O is a finite intersection of open sets, so it is open.
2. Inclusions.
 - K ⊆ O: for x ∈ K and i ∈ A, ρ(z_i + δ/2) < ρ(z_i + δ) ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − δ) < ρ(z_i + 1 − δ/2), since ρδ/2 > 0. For i ∉ A, |x_i − ρz_i| = 0 < ρ/2.
 - O ⊆ L is immediate.
 Since O is open, K ⊆ O ⊆ interior L.
3. Compactness. L ⊆ B := {x : ρz_i − ρ ≤ x_i ≤ ρz_i + ρ for all i}.
 - For i ∈ A: x_i ≥ ρz_i + ρδ/2 ≥ ρz_i − ρ and x_i ≤ ρz_i + ρ − ρδ/2 ≤ ρz_i + ρ.
 - For i ∉ A: |x_i − ρz_i| ≤ ρ/2 ≤ ρ.
 B is the image of the compact product Π_i [ρz_i − ρ, ρz_i + ρ] under the continuous WithLp.toLp. So L, a closed subset of a compact set, is compact.
4. Smooth Urysohn. ℝ^N with the model 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ^N) is a finite-dimensional smooth manifold; K is closed and K ⊆ interior L.
 - exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior (smoothness ⊤) gives a smooth f : ℝ^N → ℝ with f = 1 on a neighbourhood of K, f(x) = 0 for x ∉ L, and f(x) ∈ [0, 1] for all x.
 - f is C^∞ (contMDiff_iff_contDiff).
 - f has compact support, since it vanishes outside the compact set L (HasCompactSupport.intro).
 Put φ := f. Then 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1 and φ = 1 on K.
5. Other faces. Let z' ≠ z and x ∈ latticeFace ρ (z', α). Choose i with z'_i ≠ z_i. As integers, either z'_i + 1 ≤ z_i or z_i + 1 ≤ z'_i.
 - If i ∈ A, then ρz'_i ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z'_i + 1). In the first case x_i ≤ ρ(z'_i + 1) ≤ ρz_i < ρ(z_i + δ/2). In the second case x_i ≥ ρz'_i ≥ ρ(z_i + 1) > ρ(z_i + 1 − δ/2). Either way the i-th condition of L fails.
 - If i ∉ A, then x_i = ρz'_i, so |x_i − ρz_i| = ρ|z'_i − z_i| ≥ ρ > ρ/2.
 In all cases x ∉ L, so φ(x) = f(x) = 0. ∎
proof_key_steps: Shrunken face K ⊆ open box O ⊆ compact box L (margins ρδ/2 along range α, transversal half-width ρ/2).
Smooth Urysohn gives a C^∞ φ with values in [0,1], φ = 1 on K and φ = 0 off L; compact support follows.
Every face (z', α) with z' ≠ z lies outside L (an integer coordinate gap of at least 1), so φ vanishes there.

subproblems.title: Integral over a lattice face as an integral over the parameter cube (reused accepted declaration)
subproblems.statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, ρ ∈ ℝ, G = (w, γ) ∈ LatticeFaceIndex d P (w ∈ ℤ^P, γ : Fin d → Fin P strictly increasing) and g : ℝ^P → ℝ arbitrary (Bochner integrals; no measurability or integrability assumption). Then ∫_{latticeFace ρ G} g dH^d = ∫_{[0,ρ]^d} g(Σ_l ρ w_l e_l + Σ_j s_j e_{γ(j)}) ds. Here H^d = μHE[d] on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P), e_l = EuclideanSpace.single l 1, and the right side integrates against Lebesgue measure on Fin d → ℝ over the box Set.Icc 0 (fun _ => ρ).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (G : LatticeFaceIndex d P) (g : Eucl P → ℝ), ∫ x in latticeFace ρ G, g x ∂(μHE[d] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ s in Set.Icc (0 : Fin d → ℝ) (fun _ => ρ), g (∑ l, (ρ * (G.1 l : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ) + ∑ j, s j • EuclideanSpace.single (G.2 j) (1 : ℝ))
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: the accepted proof of the reused declaration br_latticeFace_setIntegral_eq_cube, reproduced.
- Node: root.boundary_rectifiability-a1.lattice_face_stokes-a1.lattice_face_param-a1, candidate commit 0561b355216f4041a30f4aaf2a4b139abdf038ca. Its frozen Lean type is identical, so the comparator-accepted declaration is reused.
- It is the integral form of step 1 (parametrization) of the parent proof.

Notation. G = (w, γ); e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 ∈ ℝ^P; H^d := μHE[d]; E_d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d).

1. Parametrization. Define L : E_d → ℝ^P by L(t) := Σ_l ρ w_l e_l + Σ_j t_j e_{γ(j)}.
 - Its coordinates are L(t)_l = ρ w_l + Σ_j [l = γ(j)] t_j.
 - Since γ is injective, L(t)_{γ(j)} = ρ w_{γ(j)} + t_j, and L(t)_l = ρ w_l for l ∉ range γ.
2. Isometry. L(t) − L(t') = Σ_j (t_j − t'_j) e_{γ(j)}, and the family (e_{γ(j)})_j is orthonormal (EuclideanSpace.orthonormal_single composed with the injective γ). So ‖L(t) − L(t')‖² = Σ_j (t_j − t'_j)² = ‖t − t'‖² (Orthonormal.inner_sum, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq). Thus L is an isometry, hence a closed embedding.
3. Range. latticeFace ρ G ⊆ range L. For x in the face, put t_j := x_{γ(j)} − ρ w_{γ(j)}. Then L(t)_{γ(j)} = x_{γ(j)}, and for l ∉ range γ, L(t)_l = ρ w_l = x_l by the face condition. So L(t) = x.
4. Parameter cube. For s : Fin d → ℝ, L(toLp s) ∈ latticeFace ρ G ⟺ ∀ j, ρ w_{γ(j)} ≤ ρ w_{γ(j)} + s_j ≤ ρ(w_{γ(j)} + 1), because the conditions for l ∉ range γ hold automatically. This is equivalent to 0 ≤ s_j ≤ ρ for all j. Hence toLp⁻¹(L⁻¹(latticeFace ρ G)) = Icc 0 (fun _ => ρ).
5. Change of variables. All equalities below are between Bochner integrals and need no integrability or measurability hypothesis on g.
 - Isometry.map_euclideanHausdorffMeasure gives L_*(H^d on E_d) = (H^d on ℝ^P)⌞range L. With step 3 and Measure.restrict_restrict_of_subset, ∫_{face} g dH^d = ∫_{face} g d(L_* H^d).
 - The closed-embedding change of variables (IsClosedEmbedding.setIntegral_map, valid for every g) turns this into ∫_{L⁻¹(face)} g(L(t)) dH^d(t).
 - H^d = volume on E_d (EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume).
 - WithLp.toLp : (Fin d → ℝ) → E_d is measure preserving (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp) and a measurable embedding (MeasurableEquiv.toLp). So MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_preimage_emb rewrites the integral as ∫_{toLp⁻¹(L⁻¹(face))} g(L(toLp s)) ds.
 - By step 4 this equals ∫_{Icc 0 (fun _ => ρ)} g(Σ_l ρ w_l e_l + Σ_j s_j e_{γ(j)}) ds. ∎
proof_key_steps: L(t) = Σ ρ w_l e_l + Σ t_j e_{γ(j)} is an isometry whose range contains the face.
Under toLp, L⁻¹(face) pulls back to the cube [0, ρ]^d.
Change variables: L_* H^d = H^d⌞range L, H^d = Lebesgue measure on ℝ^d, and toLp is measure preserving.

subproblems.title: Positivity of the face integral of a nonnegative continuous function positive at a relative-interior point
subproblems.statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, F = (z, α) ∈ LatticeFaceIndex n N (z ∈ ℤ^N, α : Fin n ↪o Fin N strictly increasing), g : ℝ^N → ℝ continuous with g(x) ≥ 0 for all x, and p ∈ ℝ^N with g(p) > 0. Assume p lies in the relative interior of the face: ρ z_i < p_i < ρ(z_i + 1) for every i ∈ range α, and p_i = ρ z_i for every i ∉ range α. Then 0 < ∫_{latticeFace ρ F} g dH^n, where H^n = μHE[n] is the n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (g : Eucl N → ℝ) (p : Eucl N), 0 < ρ → Continuous g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → 0 < g p → (∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range F.2 → ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ) < p i ∧ p i < ρ * ((F.1 i : ℝ) + 1)) ∧ (i ∉ range F.2 → p i = ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ))) → 0 < ∫ x in latticeFace ρ F, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl N))
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, specialized to an arbitrary continuous nonnegative g:
- step 1 (parametrization ι of the face, with ι((0, ρ)^n) the relative interior);
- the positivity argument of step 5: '∫_{F_0} ψ dH = ∫_{[0,ρ]^n} ψ(ι(y)) dy > 0, because ψ∘ι is continuous and ≥ 0 and is > 0 at ι⁻¹(p) ∈ (0, ρ)^n, hence on a small ball inside [0, ρ]^n of positive Lebesgue measure'.

Notation.
- F = (z, α) and A := range α.
- e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 ∈ ℝ^N; H := μHE[n] on ℝ^N.
- ℝ^n := Fin n → ℝ with Lebesgue measure volume.
- C := Icc 0 (fun _ => ρ) = {s : 0 ≤ s_j ≤ ρ for all j}; Q := {s : 0 < s_j < ρ for all j} = Set.pi univ (fun _ => Ioo 0 ρ).
- (H_p) is the hypothesis on p: ρz_i < p_i < ρ(z_i + 1) for i ∈ A, and p_i = ρz_i for i ∉ A.

1. Parametrization. Apply sibling face_param (br_latticeFace_setIntegral_eq_cube with P := N, d := n, G := F and our g). It gives ∫_{latticeFace ρ F} g dH = ∫_C h(s) ds, where ι(s) := Σ_l ρ z_l e_l + Σ_j s_j e_{α(j)} and h := g ∘ ι : ℝ^n → ℝ.
2. Regularity. ι is continuous: a constant plus a finite sum of the continuous maps s ↦ s_j • e_{α(j)}. So h = g ∘ ι is continuous, and h ≥ 0 because g ≥ 0.
3. Coordinates of ι. For l ∈ Fin N, ι(s)_l = ρz_l + Σ_j [l = α(j)] s_j (EuclideanSpace.single_apply). Since α is injective, ι(s)_{α(j)} = ρz_{α(j)} + s_j, and ι(s)_l = ρz_l for l ∉ A.
4. The base point. Put s₀_j := p_{α(j)} − ρz_{α(j)} for j ∈ Fin n.
 - By (H_p) at i = α(j) ∈ A, 0 < s₀_j < ρ, so s₀ ∈ Q.
 - By step 3, ι(s₀)_{α(j)} = p_{α(j)}, and for l ∉ A, ι(s₀)_l = ρz_l = p_l by (H_p).
 Hence ι(s₀) = p and h(s₀) = g(p) > 0.
5. Reduction to a measure. C is compact and h is continuous, so h is integrable on C (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact). Since h ≥ 0 everywhere (in particular a.e. on C), setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae gives: 0 < ∫_C h ⟺ 0 < volume(support h ∩ C).
6. Positive measure. Let V := support h ∩ Q.
 - V is open: support h = h⁻¹(ℝ ∖ {0}) is open since h is continuous (Continuous.isOpen_support), and Q is a finite product of open intervals (isOpen_set_pi).
 - V is nonempty: s₀ ∈ V by step 4.
 - Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n is positive on nonempty open sets (IsOpen.measure_pos), so volume(V) > 0. For n = 0, ℝ^0 is one point of measure 1 and Q is all of it, so this case is covered by the same argument.
7. Conclusion. Since Q ⊆ C, V ⊆ support h ∩ C, so volume(support h ∩ C) ≥ volume(V) > 0 (measure_mono). By steps 5 and 1, 0 < ∫_C h = ∫_{latticeFace ρ F} g dH. ∎

Remark (optional, not part of the argument): this Lean text compiled in a scratch copy of the project (Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c) with the accepted Submission.br_latticeFace_setIntegral_eq_cube available; #print axioms gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

theorem Submission.fiw_tb_lcc_face_integral_pos : ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (g : Eucl N → ℝ) (p : Eucl N), 0 < ρ → Continuous g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → 0 < g p → (∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range F.2 → ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ) < p i ∧ p i < ρ * ((F.1 i : ℝ) + 1)) ∧ (i ∉ range F.2 → p i = ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ))) → 0 < ∫ x in latticeFace ρ F, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl N)) := by
  intro n N ρ F g p hρ hg hg0 hgp hp
  rw [Submission.br_latticeFace_setIntegral_eq_cube N n ρ F g]
  -- the affine parametrization of the face
  set ι : (Fin n → ℝ) → Eucl N := fun s =>
    ∑ l, (ρ * (F.1 l : ℝ)) • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ) +
      ∑ j, s j • EuclideanSpace.single (F.2 j) (1 : ℝ) with hι
  have hιc : Continuous ι := by
    rw [hι]
    fun_prop
  have hcoord : ∀ (s : Fin n → ℝ) (l : Fin N),
      ι s l = ρ * (F.1 l : ℝ) + ∑ j, if l = F.2 j then s j else 0 := by
    intro s l
    simp [hι, Pi.single_apply]
  set s₀ : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => p (F.2 j) - ρ * (F.1 (F.2 j) : ℝ) with hs₀
  have hιs₀ : ι s₀ = p := by
    ext l
    rw [hcoord]
    by_cases hl : l ∈ range F.2
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hl
      simp [hs₀, F.2.injective.eq_iff]
    · have hne : ∀ j, l ≠ F.2 j := fun j h => hl ⟨j, h.symm⟩
      simp [hne, (hp l).2 hl]
  have hs₀mem : s₀ ∈ Set.pi univ (fun _ => Ioo (0 : ℝ) ρ) := by
    intro j _
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hp (F.2 j)).1 ⟨j, rfl⟩
    constructor <;> simp only [hs₀] <;> linarith
  have hh : Continuous fun s => g (ι s) := hg.comp hιc
  rw [setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun s => hg0 _)
    (hh.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_Icc)]
  have hopen : IsOpen (Function.support (fun s => g (ι s)) ∩ Set.pi univ (fun _ => Ioo (0 : ℝ) ρ)) :=
    hh.isOpen_support.inter (isOpen_set_pi finite_univ fun _ _ => isOpen_Ioo)
  have hne : (Function.support (fun s => g (ι s)) ∩ Set.pi univ (fun _ => Ioo (0 : ℝ) ρ)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨s₀, by simp only [Function.mem_support, hιs₀]; exact hgp.ne', hs₀mem⟩
  calc (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < volume (Function.support (fun s => g (ι s)) ∩ Set.pi univ (fun _ => Ioo (0 : ℝ) ρ)) :=
        hopen.measure_pos volume hne
    _ ≤ volume (Function.support (fun s => g (ι s)) ∩ Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) (fun _ => ρ)) := by
        refine measure_mono (inter_subset_inter_right _ fun s hs => ⟨fun j => ?_, fun j => ?_⟩)
        · exact (hs j (mem_univ j)).1.le
        · exact (hs j (mem_univ j)).2.le
proof_key_steps: Rewrite the face integral as ∫_{[0,ρ]^n} g(ι(s)) ds using face_param.
h = g∘ι is continuous, nonnegative, and integrable on the compact cube.
s₀ = (p_{α(j)} − ρz_{α(j)})_j lies in the open cube (0,ρ)^n and ι(s₀) = p, so h(s₀) = g(p) > 0.
support h ∩ (0,ρ)^n is open and nonempty, so it has positive Lebesgue measure.
setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae turns this into a positive integral.

subproblems.title: Localized isolating test form at a point of a lattice face
subproblems.statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, F₀ = (z, α) ∈ LatticeFaceIndex n N, x ∈ latticeFace ρ F₀, and W ⊆ ℝ^N open with x ∈ W. Then there is a test form ω ∈ TestFormOn univ n (a C^∞ compactly supported n-form on ℝ^N) with three properties. (1) tsupport ω ⊆ W. (2) latticeFaceAction ρ F ω = 0 for every face index F ≠ F₀. (3) latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ ω > 0. Here latticeFaceAction ρ F ω = ∫_{latticeFace ρ F} ω(y)(e_{F.2(0)}, …, e_{F.2(n−1)}) dH^n(y), with e_a = EuclideanSpace.single a 1 and H^n = μHE[n].
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F₀ : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (x : Eucl N) (W : Set (Eucl N)), 0 < ρ → x ∈ latticeFace ρ F₀ → IsOpen W → x ∈ W → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) ⊆ W ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex n N, F ≠ F₀ → latticeFaceAction ρ F (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) = 0) ∧ 0 < latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof steps 2–6 (coordinate covector, separation of parallel faces, evaluation formula, positive bump at an interior point, approximation of a face point by interior points), specialized to produce one localized test form. The separation of step 3 is supplied by the accepted cut-off isoperimetric_lattice_face_cutoff, which the parent's Remark allows: that cut-off vanishes on all other faces of direction α₀, which is all step 4 uses.

Notation.
- F₀ = (z, α) and A := range α.
- e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1; H := μHE[n] on ℝ^N.
- dx^α := wedgeCovectors n (i ↦ EuclideanSpace.proj (α i)).
- [[F]](ω) := latticeFaceAction ρ F ω.
- For δ > 0, K_δ := {y : ρ(z_i + δ) ≤ y_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − δ) (i ∈ A), y_i = ρz_i (i ∉ A)}.
- Hypotheses: ρ > 0; x ∈ latticeFace ρ F₀, i.e. ρz_i ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1) for i ∈ A and x_i = ρz_i for i ∉ A; W open; x ∈ W.

1. Centre. Let c ∈ ℝ^N with c_i := ρ(z_i + 1/2) for i ∈ A and c_i := ρz_i for i ∉ A.
2. A nearby point. The map t ↦ x + t(c − x), ℝ → ℝ^N, is continuous and sends 0 to x ∈ W. So the preimage of the open set W is open and contains 0, and there is ε > 0 with x + t(c − x) ∈ W whenever |t| < ε (Metric.isOpen_iff). Let t := min(ε/2, 1). Then 0 < t ≤ 1 and t < ε, so p := x + t(c − x) ∈ W. Coordinatewise, p_i = x_i + t(c_i − x_i).
3. p ∈ K_{t/2}.
 - For i ∈ A: p_i − ρ(z_i + t/2) = (1 − t)(x_i − ρz_i) ≥ 0 and ρ(z_i + 1 − t/2) − p_i = (1 − t)(ρ(z_i + 1) − x_i) ≥ 0. This uses c_i = ρ(z_i + 1/2), 0 < t ≤ 1 and ρz_i ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1).
 - For i ∉ A: x_i = c_i = ρz_i, so p_i = ρz_i.
 Consequently p is a relative-interior point of the face: for i ∈ A, ρz_i < ρ(z_i + t/2) ≤ p_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − t/2) < ρ(z_i + 1), because ρt/2 > 0; and p_i = ρz_i for i ∉ A.
4. Bump. W is a neighbourhood of p. By exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (ℝ^N is finite-dimensional; smoothness ⊤ : ℕ∞) there is ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ, C^∞, with compact support, tsupport ψ ⊆ W, range ψ ⊆ [0, 1] and ψ(p) = 1.
5. Cut-off. Apply sibling face_cutoff (isoperimetric_lattice_face_cutoff) with δ := t/2 > 0, z and α. It gives φ : ℝ^N → ℝ that is C^∞, compactly supported, with 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1, φ = 1 on K_{t/2} (so φ(p) = 1 by step 3), and φ(y) = 0 for every y ∈ latticeFace ρ (z', α) with z' ≠ z.
6. Covector. Apply sibling coord_covector (isoperimetric_coord_covector_eval n N α): dx^α(e_{α(0)}, …, e_{α(n−1)}) = 1, and dx^α(e_{α'(0)}, …, e_{α'(n−1)}) = 0 for every α' ∈ SimonMultiIndex n N with α' ≠ α.
7. The form. Let g := ψ·φ (pointwise product).
 - g is C^∞ as a product of C^∞ functions, has compact support because ψ does (HasCompactSupport.mul_right), satisfies g ≥ 0, and g(p) = ψ(p)φ(p) = 1.
 - Define ω(y) := g(y) • dx^α. It is C^∞ (a smooth scalar times a constant covector), has compact support (HasCompactSupport.smul_right) and tsupport ω ⊆ univ. So ω ∈ TestFormOn univ n, and ω(y)(v) = g(y)·dx^α(v).
 - tsupport ω ⊆ tsupport g ⊆ tsupport ψ ⊆ W (tsupport_smul_subset_left, tsupport_mul_subset_left, step 4). This is property (1).
8. Other faces. Let F = (z', α') ≠ F₀.
 - If α' = α, then z' ≠ z. For y ∈ latticeFace ρ F the integrand is ψ(y)φ(y)·dx^α(e_α) = 0, since φ(y) = 0 by step 5. A set integral of a function vanishing on the set is 0 (setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero).
 - If α' ≠ α, the integrand is g(y)·dx^α(e_{α'}) = 0 for all y by step 6, so the integral is 0.
 Hence [[F]](ω) = 0, which is property (2).
9. The face F₀. By step 6, [[F₀]](ω) = ∫_{latticeFace ρ F₀} g(y)·1 dH(y) = ∫_{latticeFace ρ F₀} g dH. Apply sibling face_integral_pos to (n, N, ρ, F₀, g, p). Its hypotheses hold: ρ > 0; g is continuous (being C^∞); g ≥ 0; g(p) = 1 > 0; and p satisfies the relative-interior condition by step 3. Hence [[F₀]](ω) > 0, which is property (3). ∎

Remark (optional, not part of the argument): this Lean text compiled in a scratch copy of the project (Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c) with the accepted Submission.isoperimetric_lattice_face_cutoff, Submission.isoperimetric_coord_covector_eval and the sibling Submission.fiw_tb_lcc_face_integral_pos available; #print axioms gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

theorem Submission.fiw_tb_lcc_local_isolating_form : ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F₀ : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (x : Eucl N) (W : Set (Eucl N)), 0 < ρ → x ∈ latticeFace ρ F₀ → IsOpen W → x ∈ W → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) ⊆ W ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex n N, F ≠ F₀ → latticeFaceAction ρ F (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) = 0) ∧ 0 < latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) := by
  intro n N ρ F₀ x W hρ hx hW hxW
  obtain ⟨z, α⟩ := F₀
  -- Step 1: the centre `c` of the face.
  set c : Eucl N := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => if i ∈ range α then ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + 1 / 2)
    else ρ * (z i : ℝ)) with hc
  -- Step 2: a point `p = x + t (c - x)`, `0 < t ≤ 1`, of `W`.
  have hcont : Continuous fun t : ℝ => x + t • (c - x) := by fun_prop
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => x + t • (c - x)) ⁻¹' W := by simpa using hxW
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (hW.preimage hcont) 0 h0
  set t : ℝ := min (ε / 2) 1 with ht
  have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_min (half_pos hε) one_pos
  have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
  have htε : t < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hε)
  set p : Eucl N := x + t • (c - x) with hp
  have hpW : p ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ht0]; exact htε)
  have hpcoord : ∀ i, p i = x i + t * (c i - x i) := fun i => by simp [hp]
  -- Step 3: `p` lies in the shrunken face `K_{t/2}`, hence in the open face.
  have hpK : ∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range α → ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + t / 2) ≤ p i ∧
      p i ≤ ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + 1 - t / 2)) ∧ (i ∉ range α → p i = ρ * (z i : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hx i).1 hi
      have hci : c i = ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) := by
        simp only [hc, PiLp.toLp_apply, hi, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [hpcoord, hci]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    · intro hi
      have hci : c i = ρ * (z i : ℝ) := by
        simp only [hc, PiLp.toLp_apply, hi, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [hpcoord, hci, (hx i).2 hi]
      ring
  have hpopen : ∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range α → ρ * (z i : ℝ) < p i ∧ p i < ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      (i ∉ range α → p i = ρ * (z i : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨fun hi => ?_, (hpK i).2⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hpK i).1 hi
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  -- Step 4: a bump `ψ` at `p` supported in `W`, the cut-off `φ` of the face, `dx^α`.
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψW, hψc, hψs, hψr, hψp⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) (hW.mem_nhds hpW)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφs, hφc, hφ01, hφ1, hφ0⟩ :=
    Submission.isoperimetric_lattice_face_cutoff n N ρ (t / 2) z α hρ (half_pos ht0)
  obtain ⟨hηα, hηne, -⟩ := Submission.isoperimetric_coord_covector_eval n N α
  set η : Covector (Eucl N) n := wedgeCovectors n (fun i => EuclideanSpace.proj (α i))
  -- Step 5: the test form `ω = (ψ φ) • dx^α`.
  have hgs : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => ψ y * φ y) := hψs.mul hφs
  have hgc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => ψ y * φ y) := hψc.mul_right
  obtain ⟨ω, hωx⟩ : ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n,
      ∀ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) y = (ψ y * φ y) • η :=
    ⟨⟨fun y => (ψ y * φ y) • η, ⟨hgs.smul contDiff_const, hgc.smul_right (f' := fun _ => η)⟩,
      subset_univ _⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hωv : ∀ y (v : Fin n → Eucl N), (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) y v = ψ y * φ y * η v :=
    fun y v => by rw [hωx, ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨ω, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  -- Step 6: `tsupport ω ⊆ tsupport ψ ⊆ W`.
  · have hω : (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) = fun y => (ψ y * φ y) • η := funext hωx
    rw [hω]
    exact (tsupport_smul_subset_left _ _).trans (tsupport_mul_subset_left.trans hψW)
  -- Step 7: every other face contributes `0`.
  · rintro ⟨z', α'⟩ hF
    rw [latticeFaceAction]
    by_cases hα : α' = α
    · have hz : z' ≠ z := fun h => hF (by rw [h, hα])
      refine setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun y hy => ?_
      rw [hωv, hφ0 z' hz y (by rwa [hα] at hy), mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · simp only [hωv, hηne α' hα, mul_zero, integral_zero]
  -- Step 8: `[[F₀]](ω) = ∫_{F₀} ψ φ dHⁿ > 0`.
  · have hval : latticeFaceAction ρ ((z, α) : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) =
        ∫ y in latticeFace ρ ((z, α) : LatticeFaceIndex n N), ψ y * φ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl N)) := by
      simp only [latticeFaceAction, hωv, hηα, mul_one]
    rw [hval]
    refine Submission.fiw_tb_lcc_face_integral_pos n N ρ (z, α) (fun y => ψ y * φ y) p hρ
      hgs.continuous (fun y => mul_nonneg (hψr ⟨y, rfl⟩).1 (hφ01 y).1) ?_ hpopen
    rw [hψp, hφ1 p hpK, one_mul]
    exact one_pos
proof_key_steps: Move x toward the face centre c: p = x + t(c − x) lies in W for some t ∈ (0,1].
p lies in the shrunken face K_{t/2}, hence in the relative interior of F₀.
Take a bump ψ at p with tsupport ψ ⊆ W and ψ(p) = 1, and the cut-off φ (1 on K_{t/2}, 0 on the other faces of direction α).
ω = (ψφ) dx^α is a test form on ℝ^N with tsupport ω ⊆ W.
dx^α kills faces of other directions and φ kills the parallel faces, so [[F]](ω) = 0 for F ≠ F₀.
[[F₀]](ω) = ∫_{F₀} ψφ dH^n > 0 by face_integral_pos (ψφ is continuous, nonnegative and equals 1 at p).
